info.title: dnui
info.description: The dnui command: runs Dnui UI commands (dialogs, windows, trays) from any shell. Downloads the matching Cmdless.Dnui runtime on first use. Install with: dotnet tool install -g Cmdless.Dnui.Tool

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Dnui runtime: a cached Avalonia host driven by commands.
